hero.title: Yabelana ngesiko lakho. Funda kwamanye wonke.
hero.lede: Bhala ngolimi lwakho. Funda indaba yanoma ubani ngolwakho.
how.title: Kusuka ezwini lakho kuya emhlabeni, ngemibandela yakho
how.s1: Bhala, qopha noma thwebula okuthile kwesiko lakho, ngolimi lwakho.
how.s2: Engeza ukuthi kuphi, nini nokuthi wazi kanjani. Imithombo yenza indaba ithembeke.
how.s3: Khetha ukuthi ubani oyibonayo. Abafundi bayifunda ngolimi lwabo; eyakho yokuqala iyahlala.
cultures.title: Izwe ngalinye linamasiko amaningi
cultures.lede: Ikhadi ngalinye lingumnyango. Vula elilodwa uxoxe okwaziyo.
live.empty: Ayikho indaba yomphakathi okwamanje. Yiba ngowokuqala ukwabelana.
langs.title: Bhala ngolwakho. Funda nganoma yiluphi.
langs.lede: Izilimi ezinechashaza zinokuxhumana okuhunyushwe ngomshini. Izikhulumi zingasiza ukukulungisa.
collections.title: Izinto zaseKasai
collections.lede: Amarekhodi okubhekisela eminyuziyamu, ahlukile ezindabeni zomphakathi.
rights.title: Amalungelo akho
rights.c2: Hoxisa indaba noma nini. Amakhophi asevele elandiwe awakwazi ukubuyiswa.
rights.c3: Amagama akho agcinwa njengoba uwabhalile. Ukuhumusha kuphawulwa.
machine.notice: Lolu limi luhunyushwe ngomshini futhi alukahlolwa yisikhulumi.
